overall_summary: High-scale planetary and space scenarios (e.g., Saturn's rings, atmospheric loss, sound traveling through space) generate the highest view counts and total watch time. Videos featuring extreme loopability achieve average percentage watched well over 100%, whereas abstract physical changes with slow visual hooks suffer steep drop-offs in the first 10% of playback.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' achieved 1,041 studio views (266 min watch time, 50.79% APW) and 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' reached 710 studio views.
what_is_working.action: Focus production on large-scale astronomical and global atmospheric transformations with strong visual potential.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' generated 881 studio views with 262 estimated minutes watched and 64.29% APW.
what_is_working.action: Structure hooks around brief, extreme time-bound events that create immediate urgency in the opening 2 seconds.

what_to_improve.pattern: Immediate Audience Drop-off on Abstract Physics
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' saw relative retention drop from 0.3061 at 1% progress down to 0.1017 by 10% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Replace abstract mathematical parameter changes with immediate visual consequences in the first frame.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury?' (19 views) and 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' (24 views) significantly underperformed channel averages.
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate micro-material transformation topics in favor of global-scale environmental and celestial anomalies.

retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Extreme audience hold zone across entire video length.
retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Passed Through Saturn's Rings?' maintained an audience watch ratio between 3.62x at 1% progress and 2.74x at 49% progress, yielding 195.54% APW.
retention_insights.action: Design visual transitions that connect the ending scene directly back into the opening frame to incentivize multi-loop viewing.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth's Gravity Tripled For 5 Seconds?' dropped audience watch ratio from 1.0541 at 1% to 0.1017 at 10% progress.
retention_insights.action: Front-load the visual transformation before introducing verbal context to capture immediate viewer interest.

best_posting_windows.reason: Consistently generates top-tier performance, including the top video 'Earth Had Rings Like Saturn' (1,041 views at 04:56 UTC) and 'Sound Could Travel Through Space' (710 views at 04:47 UTC).
Drives peak estimated watch time and high engagement, led by 'Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds' (881 views, 262 min watch time at 12:08 UTC).

avoid_or_limit.item: Duplicate Re-uploads of Exact Same Title
avoid_or_limit.reason: Multiple identical titles uploaded back-to-back (e.g., 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' at 04:55 and 04:56 UTC; 'What If Earth Lost Its Magnetic Field?' at 19:39 UTC) fragment views and yield near-zero views on duplicate uploads.
Scenarios like 'Water Turned Into Liquid Mercury' (19 views) and 'All Sand Turned to Glass' (24 views) lack broad audience appeal and fail to generate impressions.
